{{Quote|This is the pirat&hellip; um, private contracting ship ''Breath of the Balyeg''. We're so sick of the ''Kriffing Vong!'' We'll spread the word. Looking forward to doing some damage with you.|The crew of the ''Breath of the Balyeg''|<ref name="Revelation 3" />}}
The '''''Breath of the Balyeg''''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. It was one of the ships that answered the call to aid the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]'' when [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bylsma (New Republic)|Bylsma]] sent out a request for support to [[Battle of Shramar|defend]] [[Shramar]].<ref name="Revelation 3" /> It shared its name with the [[balyeg]], one of the most terrifying creatures in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="BT1">[[Blood Ties 1|''Blood Ties'' 1]]</ref>
